text: Wrong subcommands are handled through the legacyArgs validation function in args.go (lines 22-34), which implements subcommand validity checking. When a root command with subcommands is executed, legacyArgs performs subcommand checking against the command tree. The Command.Find method in command.go (lines 720-732) locates the target command given the args and command tree, meant to be run on the highest node and searches down. Flag-related subcommand errors are reported through the flagCompError type in completions.go (lines 44-56), which formats errors like "Subcommand 'X' does not support flag 'Y'" (e132).
